title: Second heap block gate
statement: Let $n,k,q\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$. If $1\le q<2^{k+1}$, then the gate at index $o_Z(n,k)+(q-1)$ in the construction for $f$ and parameter $k$ is the heap gate with parameters $n$, base $n+o_Z(n,k)$, offset $n-k$, and size $q$.
